entries.prompt:
The image is a grid of twelve separate photographs in four rows and three columns, all of equal size, edge to edge with no gutter, no border, no frame line, no caption, no numbering. The twelve panels are identical in exposure, white balance, background tone, camera height and subject scale, as if shot in one session on one set and laid out afterwards.

Editorial studio fashion photography contact sheet. Every panel shares one identical setup: seamless matte warm cream cyclorama background, flat pale sand tone, half a stop lighter at the top, no seam between floor and wall, no horizon line. One very large softbox key at 40 degrees camera-left and 25 degrees above, one full-height white bounce camera-right lifting the shadow side, neutral 5200K daylight, soft low-contrast light, no coloured light. 85mm lens at f/8, camera at the chest height of the garment so the piece is seen straight on and hangs true, no perspective tilt. In every panel the garment is worn by an invisible mannequin so it holds a human shape with nobody inside it, is centred, square to camera, shown full length within the panel, fills 78 percent of the panel height, has clear space above and below, and carries exactly one soft feathered contact shadow directly beneath the hem, no cast side shadow, no reflection, matte floor. Sharp focus front to back, weave and knit texture clearly visible, matte fabrics stay matte, silk reads soft and not shiny.

a midi-length bias-cut slip dress in warm ivory silk crepe with a shallow cowl neckline, thin adjustable shoulder straps and a narrow hem, worn on an invisible form so the fabric falls in soft vertical folds. Template variant V-form: the garment is worn by a full invisible mannequin, square to camera, arms slightly away from the body so the silhouette reads.
